installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

apt update
apt install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
  echo "USER_UPLOAD enabled, skipping repo clone"
  exit 0
fi

if [[ ! -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]]; then
  if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
  fi

  if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo "Using anonymous git access"
  else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
  fi

  if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    if [ -d .git ]; then
      git pull || true
    fi
  else
    if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
      git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
      git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
  fi
fi

export HOME=/mnt/server

if [[ ! -z ${PY_PACKAGES} ]]; then
  pip install -U --prefix .local ${PY_PACKAGES}
fi

if [ -f /mnt/server/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE} ]; then
  pip install -U --prefix .local -r ${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}
fi

echo "Install complete"
